subject: MicroConf attendee trial top-up request — allocation needed
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena@devcommunity.org>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MicroConf — attendee trial credit top-up request

Hi Ava,

Hope you’re well — MicroConf is next month and we have ~1,200 confirmed registrants. A bunch of our attendees signed up for the Redwood workshop and we’d like to offer a small trial/top-up so they can experiment after the session.

We’re requesting: 200 30-day trial top-up credits (redeemable via promo code), each with 30k token cap, valid for 90 days. We’ll distribute to attendees who attend the workshop and complete the feedback form.

Key asks:
- Can Redwood approve the 200 trial codes?
- Can codes be configured to auto-expire after 90 days?
- We’ll need a simple tracking parameter (utm_campaign=microconf2026) or a short redemption link to tie signups back to the event.

I attached the provisional attendee list and a short note describing the distribution plan. Budget wise, we can list it as a marketing co-op item if needed — let me know if you need a PO.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Cruz
Partnerships, DevCommunity

Attachment: microconf_attendee_list.csv (csv)
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Cruz <elena@devcommunity.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MicroConf — attendee trial credit top-up request

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the list. This sounds reasonable; a few quick clarifying questions before I route to ops:

1) Is the 200 a hard request or an estimate (we can do flexible fulfillment if you want a buffer)?
2) Do you require unique codes per attendee or a single reusable link for the cohort?
3) Any geo or sector restrictions (we have some model licensing constraints for certain regions)?

Tentative plan: I’ll coordinate with Marissa for promo/ops and with Marcus for tracking and billing. If Marissa can confirm we have the promo pool available, I can confirm back to you today.

Thanks — Ava
Ava Chen
Partner Marketing, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Ava / Marcus — quick ops check: we have a promo pool set aside for partner events but the standard process is:
- Approve the quantity (200)
- Confirm code type (single-use vs. single-link)
- Set expiration window (we can do 90 days)
- Add UTM param on redemption link for tracking

On numbers: 200 single-use codes is fine. If Elena wants a buffer, we can provision +10% but it needs sign-off from marketing budget (I can take that to finance if you want).

Compliance note: single-use codes with basic metadata are straight-forward. If they need region-blocking, we’ll need to confirm which regions — current default restricts China and parts of APAC unless licensing is cleared.

Next steps: Ava, confirm whether Elena wants single-use + 10% buffer. Marcus, can you handle the tracking link & HubSpot mapping? I’ll queue the promo creation once quantity and type are confirmed.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Growth Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: promo_rules.md (text)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Elena Cruz <elena@devcommunity.org>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MicroConf — attendee trial credit top-up request

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation:

- Approved: 220 single-use codes (200 + 10% buffer).
- Expiry: 90 days from redemption activation (system enforces).
- Token cap: 30k tokens per code.
- Region: US/EU allowed; blocked by default for CN/HK/MO per licensing. If you need APAC enabled, Elena please flag specific countries.
- Tracking: created redemption link with UTM: https://redwood.ai/redeem?code=MC2026&utm_campaign=microconf2026 (this will map to HubSpot deal DEAL-9081).

Elena: I’ll upload codes to the partner portal and send the CSV to you by EOD. Marissa, I flagged the promo in Jira: ENGINF-488.

Elena — confirming delivery timeline: codes available by Mon, Aug 2 and we’ll keep the 90-day validity. If you want a branded landing page for redemption, we can do that but it’s a separate request.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Partnerships Ops, Redwood Inference
